title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine: Deisseroth, Hegemann, Nagel
summary: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Stefan Hegemann, and Georg Nagel for their groundbreaking work on optogenetics - a technique that uses light-sensitive proteins to control neurons with unprecedented precision, revolutionizing neuroscience research.
problem_solved: Enabled precise control of specific neurons using light, allowing researchers to map and understand brain circuits that were previously inaccessible.
why_valuable: Optogenetics transformed neuroscience by providing a tool to decode brain functions and has potential applications in treating neurological disorders like Parkinson's and depression.
